deal_value.notes: Majority investment by TA; existing owner Thoma Bravo retains a 'meaningful' minority stake. Financial terms not disclosed (announced Oct 9, 2024; Jefferies advised Solifi, Goodwin advised TA).

calculable.caveats: No deal value reported by any credible outlet (PE Hub, Private Equity Wire, Leasing Life, ABF Journal all note terms undisclosed), and Solifi (private, Thoma Bravo/TA-owned) publishes no revenue/ARR/EBITDA figures.
